cause: The new verifier initially assumed Float64 JSON was always a finite number, despite the already frozen annotation contract explicitly allowing nonfinite spellings.
resolution: Verifier accepts finite numbers or declared Float64 NaN/Infinity/-Infinity spellings; independent full relation values remain equal. Production code and golden were not changed.
scope: A verifier bug, not a parser defect or unsupported production input. Subsequent final receipt records the real rerun.
